sources.ref: halde-site.html (saved copy of the Studio Halde homepage)
user, 2026-10-05: approved the brand reading in advance, no review of individual values

name.note: The name in the page metadata, the logo and the footer; the footer adds the legal form B.V., which documents leave out.

colors.primary.note: The site's clay colour: the logo, the buttons, the links and the active menu item.

colors.secondary.note: The site's linen colour, used behind the approach section and the image placeholders.

colors.foreground.note: The site's text colour, a warm near-black rather than pure black.

typography.body.note: The site's text typeface, an open Google font, embedded in documents.

typography.heading.note: The site's heading typeface, an open Google font, embedded in documents.

typography.headingWeight.note: Headings on the site are set at medium weight (500), not bold.

logo.note: The clay arch mark with STUDIO Halde from the site header, used as it is on paper and drawn light in dark mode.

voice.register.value: Calm, concrete, first person plural; addresses the client as you; talks about how people live in rooms, not about design trends.

voice.sample.value: Every project starts with a morning in the house as it is: how the light moves, where the bags get dropped, which chair everyone fights over. We draw only after that.

notes.name: We took the name from the site's metadata, the logo and the footer, and left the legal form B.V. for the invoice small print.
notes.logo: The logo is the clay arch with STUDIO Halde from the top of your site, placed on the page as it is; in dark mode it turns light.
notes.tone: We write the way your homepage does: short, plain sentences about the house and the people in it, a fixed fee and a budget stated outright, and no design jargon.
